root_keys.name: routes
root_keys.note: Checked with 'routes' not in submission — no alias chain exists

fields.name: customers
fields.note: Ordered list of 网点编码 customer IDs assigned to this vehicle; visit order matters for scoring

oneOf.note: bare list form — each element treated as a customer ID string; no dict wrapper needed

items.note: 网点编码 customer ID; each value is cast via str(c).strip()

structural_checks: routes must be present at the top level (fatal if missing)
routes must be a list — isinstance check, not just truthy (fatal if not a list)
routes must contain exactly 12 elements — one per vehicle (N_VEHICLES = 12)
each route element must be a dict or a list — any other type is a fatal error
every customer ID string must match a 网点编码 value in customers.csv where 总重量 is not NaN
every non-depot customer must appear in at least one route — no missing customers
no customer ID may appear in more than one route — no duplicates across all routes
per-route sum of 总重量 must not exceed 7125.0 (CAPACITY)
